title: Launchers move to the devices that own them: the bootstrap floor to Recovery, superclaude to CC
intention: The bootstrap floor in launchers/ moves into a Recovery device, and superclaude moves into the CC device, so each launcher lives with the device that owns it.
why: launchers/ belongs to no device, yet the outline gives its two halves to two owners: the bootstrap floor is Recovery's (7.5.3.9) and superclaude is CC's launcher (12). Akien 2026-11-04, Q#24: 'yes to both'.
traces_to: RULE 1 (encapsulation) and Law 5 (intent, state and proofs share an address); outline 7.5.3.9, 12.
how: git mv the bootstrap half into cairn/devices/recovery/ and superclaude into cairn/devices/cc/; split proofs by subject; rewrite every live reference; repoint the per-box symlink; remove launchers/. BUILDER BRIEF: A Haiku builder needs: (1) the file list: launchers/ = bootstrap.sh, bootstrap_first_run.sh, superclaude, intention+why.json, state.json, history.json, probes/reported_but_unfixed_floor.py, proofs/ (PROOF.md + 10 test files), validations/; (2) the split rule: a proof whose subject is superclaude (test_superclaude_*, and any test that runs superclaude) goes to cairn/devices/cc/proofs/, every other to cairn/devices/recovery/proofs/; validations are re-made by sealing, never copied; (3) use git mv so history follows; (4) the reference rewrite: `git grep -n launchers` and fix each live hit by reading it (bin/cairn, bin/cmd/*, hooks under cairn/tools/*/hooks and devices/*/hooks, build_inspector/inspector.py, pyproject.toml, .gitattributes, README.md, MAP.md, scratch.py, intentions_model_compiler); (5) charter writes ride the artifact door and poke recompile_gate.sh; (6) the symlink: ln -sfn <cairn>/cairn/devices/cc/superclaude ~/.local/bin/superclaude on this box, and tell akiendell_cc_0 to do the same where it applies; (7) no behaviour change in either script beyond paths it computes from its own location (superclaude derives CAIRN_ROOT from its own path: check the parent depth).
falsifier: Done when launchers/ does not exist; `cairn superclaude` and `superclaude` (the per-box symlink, repointed) launch CC from cairn/devices/cc/superclaude on akiendelllinux and on akiendell; bootstrap.sh runs from cairn/devices/recovery/; every moved proof is green and sealed at its new address; `git grep -n 'launchers/'` outside history.json, validations and .jsonl journals returns nothing. Horizon: the next superclaude launch on each box. Wrong intent if Recovery is found not to be its own device (then the floor berths under the device that holds it).
decisions: The bootstrap floor (bootstrap.sh, bootstrap_first_run.sh, the launchers charter, its probe and its proofs) moves to cairn/devices/recovery/.
superclaude and its proofs move to cairn/devices/cc/.
A proof goes with the script it exercises.
No forwarding stubs: launchers/ is removed.
Folding sudo_relay into Recovery is out of this ticket.
No behaviour change; superclaude's self-located paths are re-derived for the new depth.

decisions.text: Build step: git mv launchers/bootstrap.sh, bootstrap_first_run.sh, intention+why.json, state.json, history.json and probes/ to cairn/devices/recovery/; then edit the charter there (through the artifact door) so it names the Recovery device and its address, and poke recompile_gate.sh.

Build step: git mv launchers/superclaude to cairn/devices/cc/superclaude; git mv test_superclaude_* to cairn/devices/cc/proofs/, every other launchers proof and PROOF.md to cairn/devices/recovery/proofs/; delete launchers/validations (they are re-made by sealing at the new address).
decisions.step: unlisted: build step: superclaude to cc

decisions.text: Build step: in superclaude the repo root becomes $here/../../.. (lines 290 logger, 501 loop root, 587 web root), bootstrap becomes $repo/cairn/devices/recovery/bootstrap.sh (line 299), memlink becomes $here/scripts/memory_link.py (line 348); in bootstrap.sh CAIRN_REPO_ROOT becomes $dir/../../.. ; bootstrap_first_run.sh REPO_ROOT the same; each proof's REPO/ROOT parents index is recounted.

Build step: _cairn_wire_single relinks when the instance link is a symlink pointing anywhere but the new script (stale or dangling); a link already pointing right, and a real file, are left alone; the superclaude wire line names $CAIRN_REPO_ROOT/cairn/devices/cc/superclaude.

Build step: rewrite every live hit of git grep 'launchers/' (excluding history.json, validations/, .jsonl journals and instance-space ~/.cairn/launchers/ paths) to the new address, reading each; bin/cmd/* and the hooks get BOOTSTRAP=$REPO/cairn/devices/recovery/bootstrap.sh; .gitattributes names the two moved scripts; then re-install .git/hooks with cairn test --reseal-install.

Build step: ln -sfn the new superclaude at ~/.local/bin/superclaude and ~/.cairn/devices/superclaude/0/bin/superclaude on this box; ask akiendell_cc_0 to re-run cairn_wire_instances (or relink) on akiendell after it pulls.
decisions.step: unlisted: build step: links on the boxes

decisions.text: Build step: run cairn/devices/recovery/proofs/test_launchers_moved_to_their_devices.py and every moved proof twice; seal each at its new address.

Addresses (measured 2026-11-04): _cairn_wire_single is defined in launchers/bootstrap.sh lines 337-349 inside cairn_wire_instances; recompile_gate.sh is cairn/tools/intentions_model_compiler/recompile_gate.sh; launchers/probes/ holds reported_but_unfixed_floor.py; launchers/proofs/ holds PROOF.md and test_a_unit_a_test_run_starts_is_the_runs, test_bootstrap, test_ground_loop_survives_its_caller, test_launchers_probes_report_to_the_watch, test_launchers_reach_into_no_device, test_reported_but_unfixed_probe, test_superclaude_memory_scope, test_superclaude_sets_cairn_user, test_superclaude_wire, test_the_unswapped_arm_measures_swap_first (.py); .gitattributes line 5 is 'launchers/* text eol=lf'. The steps run in order D-first to D-last; each later step acts on the files the earlier ones moved.
decisions.step: unlisted: addresses the steps act on

decisions.text: On akiendell the relink is a message to akiendell_cc_0 over cairn mail, not a builder action here; the build is done on this box when the local links point at the new superclaude, and the falsifier's akiendell half is checked on the next launch there.

The PROVEME crossing names only cairn/devices/recovery/proofs/test_launchers_moved_to_their_devices.py: the 12 moved proofs declare their own tickets, not this one, and the composite tooth tooth_files_are_home already requires each at its new address with a green seal there — so this ticket leans on them through its own proof, never by naming them (FIXME 1..12 are one lack: the record named proofs that do not declare the ticket).
